brief:
Taekwondo athletes have returned to training at Al-Bureij Camp in central Gaza, resuming the sport after a three-year interruption, Middle East Eye reported. The resumption marks a return to normalcy for the athletes amid ongoing devastation across the territory.

The training sessions represent an effort to rebuild community life and athletic activity in Gaza following years of conflict that severely disrupted daily routines and infrastructure across the enclave.
dek: Amid Gaza's ruins, Taekwondo athletes return to training after three years of genocide At Al-Bureij Camp in central Gaza, Taekwondo athletes are back on the mat after three years of genocide.
title: Gaza taekwondo athletes resume training after three-year conflict halt
